instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Mid-size quarrying operation extracting high-grade limestone and granite for the construction industry. We operate 3 active quarries and supply 40+ contractors across the region, relying heavily on heavy machinery and complex logistics. Major capital investment in automated cutting and crushing equipment is currently under evaluation as a key driver to enhance operational efficiency.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring to improve customer acquisition efficiency.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory by diversifying revenue streams. We are willing to make significant strategic bets—potentially including M&A, new product lines focused on specialized aggregates, or geographic expansion—provided they have a credible path to meaningful revenue contribution within 18 months.
answers.additionalContext: Supply chain volatility and fluctuating global commodity prices present continuous operational challenges that require agile decision-making and adaptive process innovation.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.

opportunities.title: Full Operational Automation of Crushing Processes
opportunities.rationale: Automating existing core processes (cutting and crushing) directly addresses current efficiency bottlenecks and improves throughput. This is a low-risk initiative that leverages the company's planned capital investment to standardize output quality and reduce labor costs.

first_actions: Conduct a feasibility study on sensor integration for primary crusher monitoring.
Identify and secure budget allocation for pilot automation unit testing.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: 30% reduction in processing cycle time within 12 months.
milestones: Q3: Feasibility Study Complete and ROI Model Approved.
Q4: Pilot Automation Unit Installed and Operational.

opportunities.title: Development of Predictive Maintenance SaaS Platform
opportunities.rationale: Creating a software solution leveraging IoT and AI to predict equipment failure in real-time moves Quantum Digital from being purely an extractor to a technology provider. This radical shift creates entirely new, recurring revenue streams by selling data insights rather than just raw materials.

first_actions: Define Minimum Viable Product (MVP) features for predictive analytics dashboard.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 pilot agreements with mid-sized contractors.
milestones: Q2: MVP Feature Set Defined and Initial Prototype Complete.
Q4: Successful Pilot Deployment and Feedback Loop Established.

next_steps.action: Formalize the M&A due diligence process for regional specialized aggregate suppliers.
Launch internal training program focused on bridging the gap between manual operational teams and new digital tools (e.g., AI dashboard usage).

key_weaknesses: Significant internal culture resistance to adopting necessary process changes and automation.
Inconsistent application of innovation methodology across the business, leading to siloed digital maturity pockets.
Talent scarcity in specialized data science and predictive maintenance engineering roles.
Reliance on a small leadership team which may lack deep industry-specific expertise in emerging technology trends.
